scope: PDF transfer-function and matte-unpremultiplication cooperative cancellation

implementation.transfer: Poll every 1024 scalar entries for single functions and every 1024 RGB pixels for four functions; abort decode without publishing partial data.
implementation.matte: Poll before work, every 1024 RGB or luma pixels and before returning; preserve original arithmetic.

vendor_image_color.matte: 6147 pixels each in RGB and luma, alpha including 0 and 255, byte-exact independent original formula, cancellation at every observed checkpoint

limitations: Transfer-function cancellation does not yet have a dedicated every-checkpoint unit fixture.
Encoded filters, mask decoding, component unpacking and final renderer flush remain incompletely interruptible.
No new latency ceiling or complete process-memory cap is established.
